# thoth_siem_decision_stream (Resource)

Sends enforcement decisions to the workspace's SIEM destination as they are recorded. Needs a SIEM destination first (`thoth_siem_settings`; add `depends_on`). Prompts are never sent, and tool arguments only as `thoth_data_handling` keeps them. Destroying this resource turns the stream off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thoth_siem_decision_stream" "this" {
  decisions = "non_allow" # non_allow | all
  # allow_sample_rate = 0.1 # with decisions = "all": share of ALLOW decisions sent

  depends_on = [thoth_siem_settings.this]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_sample_rate` (Number) With `decisions = "all"`, the share of `ALLOW` decisions sent, from 0 to 1 (default 1). Holds and blocks are never sampled.
- `decisions` (String) `non_allow` sends holds and blocks (default); `all` sends every decision.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether decisions are sent. Default `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier (tenant ID).
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID resolved from provider configuration.

## Import

```shell
terraform import thoth_siem_decision_stream.this <tenant_id>
```
